Subject: Quick ask — attendee trial bumps after yesterday's stream

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for running the demo during BrightForge's partner webinar yesterday. We had great turnout, but a number of attendees flagged they couldn't redeem the 14-day trial codes in time because the registration email went to promotions.

Two asks from our side: 1) Can Redwood extend an extra 14 days onto the trial window for the registrant pool (approx. 1,200 emails) so participants who missed activation still get the full trial? 2) Could you issue a small batch of passcodes (3,000 promo units) we can distribute to high-engagement leads? We can put the distribution list together and send over a CSV.

We know this is outside the usual promo cadence so appreciate any flexibility. If needed we can take a credit or invoice adjustment.

Best,
Samira

Looping finance/ops because hitting 3,000 promo units is a non-trivial request. Quick take: 3,000 promo units at our current unit cost would approximate a $2.7k exposure if fully converted. We can absorb that under the Q1 partner promo pool but need approval for the trial window extension separately (product/ops to ensure no billing gaps).

Laura — any objections to issuing single-use passcodes vs. a shared pool? Single-use is easiest to reconcile but a little more operational overhead to produce and deliver. Also: recommend we scope to the 600 highest-engagement registrants for the passcodes and keep the extended trial as a blanket +14 days for all 1,200 registrants — that minimizes operational rework.

If you all agree I can approve up to 3,000 units from partner pool; just confirm the distribution CSV and we’ll have Ops seed the codes by Wed.

-Marissa

All — ops notes: we can do the +14 day extension by running an idempotent script against the registrant list; it's safe. For passcodes, Ops prefers to generate single-use codes (one CSV to us) — reduces fraud and simplifies redemption metrics. Production timeline: if we get the final CSV by EOD Tue we can seed codes Wed AM and share the codes with BrightForge via secure link.

One caveat: if BrightForge wants the codes pre-batched by cohort (e.g., enterprise prospects vs. community), include an extra column in the CSV with cohort tags.

Ben

Samira — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. We’ll proceed as follows:

- Redwood will apply a +14 day extension to the trial window for all 1,200 registrants (idempotent script).
- We will generate 3,000 single-use passcodes and reserve up to 600 of those for BrightForge high-engagement leads per your cohort tags; remaining codes are held for outreach follow-ups.
- Delivery plan: BrightForge to provide the CSV in the template (email, first_name, last_name, cohort) by EOD Tue. Ops will seed codes Wed AM and send a password-protected Google Sheet link and a short distribution guide.
- Accounting: Marissa approved charging the partner promo pool; will reconcile in monthly partner spend.

Can you confirm acceptance and send the CSV? Once we have it we’ll kick off Ops.

Appreciate it — Avery
